name: myGov
body: Structured data that parses, a security.txt, alt text on every image, and a start page that arrives fast. But 17 links on the English home page use /content/mygov/ paths that 301 to /en/, so every click takes an extra hop.
lesson: Have the CMS write public URLs into links; keep redirects for old links only.
summary: my.gov.au scores 84 out of 100 (B). 0 checks fail now, 22 are at risk, and 17 pass. Fix first: referrer-Policy is not sent.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages read.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages read.

fix.title: 12 internal links go through a redirect
fix.evidence: /content/mygov/en/about → /en/about, /content/mygov/en/about/help/contact → /en/about/help/contact, /content/mygov/en/about/feedback → /en/about/feedback, /content/mygov/audit → /en/audit. Each hop costs crawl budget and a little speed.
fix.fix: Point the links straight at the final address.

fix.title: 1 page asks search engines not to index it
fix.fix: Remove noindex from pages that should be found, and keep it only on private or duplicate pages.

fix.title: 1 page names another URL as canonical
fix.evidence: / → /en. Search engines will usually index the other URL instead.
fix.fix: Make each page's canonical point at itself unless it is a real duplicate.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 283 ms
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
